lines: The doubts are louder. The problems look *bigger.*
One more month. One more *try.* One more door.
And they never get to see what was *waiting.*
Maybe this is the *month* it turns.
You'll never know if you stop *now.*
Think about the person you were when you *started.*
You don't need to feel strong.
You just need to not *quit* tonight.
end: Send this to someone thinking about giving up.

post.title: If You're About to Give Up Tonight, Watch This
post.caption: Don't decide anything tonight. The morning always looks different. 🌙
post.first_comment: Type 'NOT TONIGHT' if you're still fighting 👇
